verdict.rationale: Shortcut's REST v3 docs state that it provides machine-readable versions of its API in both Swagger and OpenAPI formats, which directly delivers this story. The probe 404s only hit guessed default paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known), not a documented download link, so they do not concretely contradict the claim, but they do lower confidence. Missing for 10: the documented download location or URL of the spec, details on spec version or completeness, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec can actually be fetched.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: We provide machine-readable versions of our API specified in Swagger and OpenAPI.
